# Task and Change Templates

Use the templates in this directory for every task record and change description.

Blank or unstructured records are not accepted. Choose the template that matches the work, fill in every required section, and keep the acceptance and validation checklists intact.

## Templates

- `tasks/`: scoped task records by type (bug, documentation, feature, improvement, refactor, task).
- `change-description.md`: description that accompanies a proposed change.
